name: Evergreen Collaborative
summary: A US climate policy group that researches and drafts federal and state clean-energy policy and makes the public case for it, including the Inflation Reduction Act and state clean-electricity standards. Gifts to Evergreen Collaborative, a 501(c)(3), are tax-deductible; its sister Evergreen Action, a 501(c)(4) that does the lobbying, takes non-deductible gifts.
